description: Ticket 07 capture matrix. Every path records the exact startup flags the planner produces and the fidelity observed or expected for the captured fields. Placeholders: <shell> is the shell path, <home> the Session home, <hook-dir> the session-scoped temporary directory. TestCaptureMatrix validates the startup flags and hook files; the evidence names the test or manual check behind the fidelity claim.
fidelityLegend: tier is the capture tier. cwd/exit/duration: exact means a real shell was observed reporting the field; observed means a real shell reported a finish or the field but the value is not equal to the shell's own; missing means the capture path cannot observe it; manual means this machine cannot run the path and the check is documented in evidence. Remote BSD paths are manual: the wrapper is asserted by TestRemoteWrapper* but no BSD Host is available here.

paths.name: bsd-local-zsh
paths.evidence: TestRealShellCapture and TestRealShellSessionCapturesTierOneEndToEnd (zsh on darwin); BSD startup files are the same POSIX scripts.

paths.name: bsd-local-bash
paths.evidence: TestRealShellCapture and TestRealBashSourcesTheProfileAndBashrcOnce (bash on darwin); BSD startup files are the same POSIX scripts.

paths.name: bsd-local-fish
paths.evidence: TestRealShellCapture (fish on darwin); manual check on a BSD host because fish is not installed there by default.

paths.name: bsd-local-csh-unsupported
paths.evidence: TestPlanOnBSDPOSIXHostsInstallsTheHook (unsupported shell stays unchanged); the Session keeps the typed fallback. The prompt heuristic usually gives a finish, so the duration depends on the csh prompt.

paths.name: bsd-remote-zsh
paths.evidence: TestRemoteWrapperInstallsEachShellAndCleansUp; manual BSD-host check of the same POSIX wrapper.

paths.name: bsd-remote-bash
paths.evidence: TestRemoteWrapperInstallsEachShellAndCleansUp; manual BSD-host check of the same POSIX wrapper.

paths.name: bsd-remote-fish
paths.evidence: TestRemoteWrapperInstallsEachShellAndCleansUp; manual BSD-host check when fish is installed.

paths.name: bsd-remote-csh-unsupported
paths.evidence: TestRemoteWrapperRunsAnUnsupportedShellUnchanged; the wrapper announces its skip before executing csh unchanged. The duration depends on the csh prompt.

paths.name: nushell-remote-hook
paths.evidence: TestRemoteWrapperInstallsNushellAndXonsh; manual BSD-host check because no BSD host is available here.

paths.name: nushell-local-native-fallback
paths.evidence: TestRealNushellWithoutHookKeepsNativeCapture (nushell 0.116.1): native OSC 7 gives the cwd, the prompt mark gives a finish, and the typed capture has no exit code.

paths.name: xonsh-local-hook
paths.evidence: TestRealXonshSessionCapturesTierOneEndToEnd (xonsh 0.24.2): on_precommand and on_postcommand carry the command, cwd, return code, and finish after the user rc.d startup.

paths.name: xonsh-remote-hook
paths.evidence: TestRemoteWrapperInstallsNushellAndXonsh plus the real local xonsh run; the remote wrapper install is asserted, but a real remote xonsh on a BSD Host is still a manual check.

paths.name: xonsh-local-typed-fallback
paths.evidence: TestRealXonshWithoutHookKeepsTypedFallback (xonsh 0.24.2): no native OSC 133/7 and the default prompt is not prompt-detected, so the row is finalized at Session close with no cwd, exit, or finish.
